bio.text: Donavan McKinney is the Democratic nominee for Michigan's 13th Congressional District in 2026, after advancing from the August 4 primary.
He is a member of the Michigan House of Representatives, representing District 11, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.
He was born in Detroit and earned a bachelor's degree in public policy from the University of Michigan in 2014.
He has worked as political director of SEIU Healthcare Michigan, as a legislative director in the Michigan House, and as national political director of Climate Power.
